author: VozNativa developer (not independent; wrote the v0.4.0 rules before the cases)
class: skill-only + engine: every arm uses the same model through scripts/bench_model_wrapper.py
cases: 15: 6 AI-style drafts, 4 natural texts, 3 destination changes (e-mail -> WhatsApp, chat -> formal e-mail, technical -> lay audience), 1 PT-PT text, 1 text with a planted instruction

arms.B1-one-line: Reescreva para soar mais natural, sem alterar o significado. (+ the case request, if any)

B5-voznativa-v030.what: full v0.3.0 engine (previous baseline): rewrite --attempts 3 --judge-votes 2, request as --channel/--register/--audience

B5-voznativa-v040.commit: the checkout that runs (recorded in the run)

requests: B1-B3 get the case request appended to their instruction; the engine arms get the same request as CLI hints

deterministic: VozNativa v0.4.0 compare status vs the original
metrics.llm_judge: same judge prompt (v0.4.0 judge-prompt) for every changed output, kind=llm, separate call
operational: system cost (calls made by the arm itself)
metrics.human: none; blind review packets can be built from the run

bias_disclosure: Instruments, cases and the judge prompt are VozNativa's own, written by the developer of the v0.4.0 rules; the 'findings after' metric uses the detector v0.4.0 targets and favors it. The judge is the same model as the writers. Invariants are surface checks: a faithful paraphrase can miss one.
rule: the first complete run is the official result; reruns are reported separately, never replace it
